# Required Public Pages

Public demos have a real publisher. That publisher needs real legal pages that describe the actual public website operation. The fictional customer shown inside the demo cannot stand in for the real operator.

## Real operator pages

At minimum, public demos should route users to:

- real operator Impressum / legal notice
- real operator Datenschutzerklärung / privacy policy

These pages must describe the actual operator and the actual processing on the public site: hosting, server logs, forms, analytics, embedded services, fonts, maps, e-mail handling, processors, retention, user rights, and supervisory authority where applicable.

## Boundary with fictional pages

Fictional sample legal pages may exist inside a preview. They must be labelled as sample/demo/fictitious and must not read as the real provider identification of the public website.

Use source files under [Fictional Demo](../Fictional_Demo/linker_Fictional_Demo.md) when editing those sample pages.
